title: Roommate 3: Ryouko Kaze no Kagayaku Asa ni
native_title: ルームメイト３ ～涼子 風の輝く朝に～
overview:
"Will these feelings reach you..."

Inoue Ryouko, back from America, comes to stay at your home as a lodger once more, this time for a month. With university entrance exams and graduation ahead, her life is at a crossroads. The story begins on a set day in February and unfolds in real time, linked to the Saturn's internal clock, so you spend a few minutes with her each day over the course of the month.

Your choices shape how close the two of you become and can lead to special events. Leave messages for Ryouko and enjoy mini-games such as gardening as your days together go by.

「この想い届きますか・・・」
